gap: No result ChatGPT got states which Mobile Pixels stand accessory pairs with the Duex DS screens for freestanding use: the maker's store lists the Levstand ($15.99) as working with all Duex series monitors, while its Kickstand lists only the DUEX Pro, TRIO and TRIO Max and is sold out.
standout_why: Compared against deskgearhq.com (cited), legitproductreviews.com (cited), itechguides.com '15 Best' and our own under-$300 page; deskfinds.com returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Between them they already state most of the compatibility story: single-cable use needs USB-C DisplayPort Alt Mode with mini HDMI as the fallback and no driver (deskgearhq, legitproductreviews, Dealectric); one added screen stays inside the base M1/M2 MacBook one-external-display limit (legitproductreviews, Dealectric); the Plus DS suits 13- to 14-inch laptops (itechguides); a USB-C and an HDMI cable are in the box and Switch/Android work (deskgearhq). legitproductreviews also says kickstand mode needs a separately sold stand, but names neither the stand nor its price. What they lack is small: the named stand and price, the maker's Samsung DeX wording, the Type-A adapter on the boxed cable, and that the Nexus did not come up in a search of the maker's US store. The maker's product pages and manual, where a deciding exclusion would sit, could not be read: mobilepixels.us returned HTTP 429 on every product-page attempt, and the two manual PDFs downloaded but the text extraction command was not approved.
decides: It confirms the pick and does not change it. The Duex Max DS remains the one-added-screen answer under $250 for a laptop with a video-capable USB-C port, or with HDMI plus USB power, and one added screen needs only one external display from the laptop. The Duex Float 2 Pro also fits the budget at $247.99 on the store today, so at least two of our rows qualify and the page is not a skip. It sits $2.01 under the line on a timed sale, and our under-$300 page gives Mobile Pixels' fit range as 15–16-inch laptops. The stand finding adds one practical cell: to use a Duex DS freestanding, the store's matching accessory is the Levstand, not the Kickstand. The two ChatGPT picks we don't link (UPERFECT 14-inch 2K, Mobile Pixels Nexus) have no maker-sourced video path from this research, so neither can be given a compatibility row yet.
